topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I don’t know what to do. Everything I’ve worked for, all the late nights and early mornings, they could all crumble because of this. I never thought this would happen. I researched, I wrote, I cited every source. But now, the committee says they found similarities in my paper and someone else's work. I can’t even remember every article I read; there were so many. I’m thinking about what to say in my defense, but the more I think, the more jumbled everything gets. I need to find a way to show them I did my own work, that I respect academic integrity. Please, if anyone knows how to fix this, I’m ready to listen.
